player_0.content: New plan: I incorrectly identified "Disgusted" as the primary emotion because Jackson's final line ("Better than pretending to be something I'm not") sounded defensive and self-righteous. However, looking back at the dialogue, Jackson explicitly admitted, "You're right, I've never had to worry about surviving," which directly validates Alejandro's core argument about survival. This admission indicates Jackson finally comprehended Alejandro's perspective, making "Understood" the most accurate emotional response. Next time, I will prioritize identifying moments where a character explicitly concedes a point or validates the other's worldview as the strongest indicator of "Understood," rather than focusing on the tone of the final retort. I will re-evaluate the scores to reflect that Jackson feels understood (high score) and less disgusted (lower score) than previously thought.
